content:
As the Liquid Glass redesign continues to roll out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is testing another visual change, this time focusing on the style of chat bubbles. Here's what we know so far.

A fresh, more rounded chat bubble design

Several months ago, WhatsApp finally began rolling out its Liquid Glass redesign more widely after months of testing and refinement, distributing it to select user groups via TestFlight.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted signs in the app's code suggesting that WhatsApp's chat bubbles would be redesigned. According to the site's latest report, the new bubble design has begun rolling out to some users on the latest TestFlight version.

The following is quoted from WABetaInfo's report:

In addition to the change in message bubble shape, the new design also adjusts how media and links are displayed in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green borders surrounding them, giving photos, videos, animated GIFs, and link previews a cleaner, more unified look.

According to WABetaInfo, the new design is currently only available to a small number of WhatsApp TestFlight users, and there is no confirmed timeline for a full rollout to all iOS users.
